conceptual_change: Introduce a liquidity sweep confirmation mechanism that monitors for price retracement intensity following a rolling 50-period volume-weighted price deviation to validate structural liquidity grabs.
rationale: By utilizing the distance between the current close and the 50-period VWAP as a volatility filter, we can differentiate between standard range noise and authentic ICT-style liquidity sweeps (springs/upthrusts). This focuses on high-conviction zones.
